paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得谈话中注意又回到早先的身体感觉，但不清楚先有担心还是先被打断；另一次只记得比较过以前的感觉。回忆中的注意、比较与未知可以分别保留，不推定身体或心理原因。例子不要求寻找感觉、重现当时状态、查看身体或用一次分心检验健康。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls attention returning to an earlier bodily feeling during a conversation, without knowing whether concern or interruption came first. Another recollection contains only a comparison with an earlier feeling. Remembered attention, comparison and unknowns remain separate without a physical or psychological cause being assigned. The scene requires no sensation search, recreated state, body examination or health test through distraction.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“我想谈回忆中注意被拉回的经历；原因还不清楚；身体细节想留给合适的专业谈话。”可以只读虚构卡。听者不说只是想太多，不要求证明感觉真实，也不通过反复检查提供安心保证。先问哪种谈话适合，不用计数裁定身体问题或担忧谁更重要。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card names remembered returning attention, leaves the cause unknown and reserves physical details for an appropriate professional conversation. Reading only the fictional card is enough. A listener offers no overthinking explanation, demands no proof that a feeling is real and uses no repeated checking to provide reassurance. Discussion can begin with what kind of conversation may help, without counts deciding whether the physical question or worry matters more.

paragraphs.zh: 新增情境与交流卡为费马编辑部原创，可只读，不是SHAI、诊断、身体检查或治疗练习。21条仍保留三组各七条的六类记录；计数算陈述，不算就诊、搜索、提问或疾病次数，未计分不补零。三个可重叠的主题是阅读分组，不建立患病概率、原因、严重度或医疗使用是否适当。原观察尚无独立验证、常模或中英文测量等值；四周是编辑回忆时段，不是诊断时长或求助等待期。任何组合不保证症状无害或只是焦虑，不决定是否需要更多检查，不授权推迟评估、取消照护、改药或调整专业人士要求的监测。三篇全文与支持说明无需作答；复制仅含公开标题与入口，不含私人类别、症状、消息或健康资料。
paragraphs.en: These additional scenes and conversation cards are original FermatMind Editorial material for optional reading, not SHAI, diagnosis, physical examination or treatment exercises. Twenty-one descriptions retain three six-category records of seven. Counts concern statements, not visits, searches, questions or illnesses; unscored is not zero. Three overlapping topics organise reading and establish no illness probability, cause, severity or appropriateness of healthcare use. The original observations lack independent validation, norms or established English–Chinese measurement equivalence; four weeks is an editorial recall window, not a diagnostic duration or waiting period for support. No pattern guarantees that a symptom is harmless or only anxiety, decides whether more tests are needed, or authorises postponed assessment, cancelled care, changed medicine or altered monitoring requested by a professional. All three guides and support information need no answers. Copying contains only the public title and entry, without private categories, symptoms, messages or health information.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得希望把一个术语再解释一次，同时又犹豫如何开口；另一段记忆只留下对健康消息内容的不确定。想问、犹豫和背景不明可以并存，不相减成一种求医风格，也不判断问题是否多余。例子不要求打开消息、再次搜索、联系谁或改变预约与既有照护。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls wanting a term explained again while hesitating over how to ask. Another recollection contains only uncertainty about a health message. Wanting to ask, hesitation and unknown context can coexist without being subtracted into one care-seeking style or a judgment that a question is unnecessary. The scene requires no message opening, further search, contact or change to appointments and existing care.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡区分“仍不清楚的说明”“想了解的流程”和“希望保留的背景”，不必列就诊次数或展示消息。可以只谈虚构例子。听者先问对方想要陪伴还是整理问题，不代替专业人士裁定医疗需要，也不保证能消除全部不确定；已有照护不等待这张卡完成。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card separates an unclear explanation, a process someone wants to understand and context they wish to keep private, without a visit tally or displayed messages. Use only the fictional example if preferred. A listener asks whether company or help framing a question is wanted, makes no professional care decision and promises no removal of all uncertainty. Existing care does not wait for a completed card.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得一则一般故事让自己想到严重可能性，但不知道哪些信息适用于自己；另一次只记得眼前任务变得难以注意。故事、想到的可能与适用性未知可以分别保留，不计算患病概率，也不替身体感觉找无害解释。例子不要求重讲害怕结果、搜索证据或用相反想法争辩。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls a general story bringing a serious possibility to mind without knowing which information applies personally. Another occasion is remembered only as difficulty attending to a present task. The story, imagined possibility and unknown relevance stay separate without an illness probability or harmless explanation for a physical feeling. The scene requires no retelling of feared outcomes, evidence search or argument using an opposite thought.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“我想了解怎样谈这份不确定；不想重述具体结果；也有身体方面的问题想向合适专业人士询问。”可以只读，不讲自己的经历。听者不确认最坏情况，也不保证绝不会发生，不以想法频率判断叙述可信度；可尊重细节边界，而不把这张卡当成评估或治疗。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card asks how to discuss uncertainty without retelling a specific outcome and leaves room for a physical question to an appropriate professional. Read without a personal account. A listener confirms no worst outcome, promises no impossibility and judges no credibility from thought frequency. Details can remain private without making the card an assessment or treatment.
